heading.text: Prepare your identity and address documents

source_wording.text:
Individuals prepare their NIC (Sri Lankans) or valid passport (foreign nationals). Add the business registration certificate if a proprietorship is to be added, and proof of address (a utility bill, a bank statement or passbook, or a Grama Niladhari certificate) if the address is different from the NIC. Foreign nationals need a local address proof.

Manually curated official-source snapshot retrieved 22 October 2026 from the 2026 Inland Revenue Department taxpayer guideline (TIN section) and its registration overview page, cross-checked against an older Government Information Centre service description supplied for this project; not independently validated, not live output, and not an official application service. Scope: obtaining a TIN as an individual, a partnership or a registered company. Other entity types (institutions, branches, joint ventures, projects, trusts) have separate document lists in the guideline and are not covered. Counter hours, the 20-minute service time and the old tax-category names in the older description are historical and are not used. The registration overview page was last updated in 2020. In the 2026 guideline the wording of the Form 18 condition was only partly readable in the copy used, so that document is marked as applying only where applicable. Verify current requirements with the department.

concise.text: Prepare your NIC or passport, plus proof of address if it differs from your NIC.

detailed.text: Prepare your NIC if you are a Sri Lankan, or a valid passport if you are a foreign national. Add the business registration certificate only if a proprietorship is to be added, and proof of address (a utility bill, a bank statement or passbook, or a Grama Niladhari certificate) only if your address is different from the one on your NIC. Foreign nationals need a local address proof.

text.text: The older service description says that photocopies of the supporting documents accompany the application.
